spell.frierenvoid.singularity.guide: A palm-sized core grows progressively as it rises into the sky. Air curves into a wide luminous disk, which draws in enemies and real terrain. Absorbed blocks vanish without drops. A brilliant flash and shockwaves end the spell. Allies, pets and block entities are protected. Terrain absorption can be disabled in server settings.
message.frierenvoid.occupied: A singularity is already active, or this dimension has reached its limit.
spell.frierenvoid.zoltraak.guide: A white flower seal fires a piercing beam. With this spell selected, press the Cycle Zoltraak Mode key (default: Left Shift; rebind in Controls) to cycle Single / Rapid / Large. Large shots break ordinary terrain and split against resistant blocks. In Rapid mode, hold the cast button to keep firing guided shots; continued fire consumes extra mana. Large mode consumes twice the base cast mana.
spell.frierenvoid.black_zoltraak.guide: A white flower seal fires a black beam with flowing ink and a grainy pale rim. With this spell selected, press the Cycle Zoltraak Mode key (default: Left Shift; rebind in Controls) to cycle Single / Rapid / Large. Large shots break ordinary terrain and split against resistant blocks. In Rapid mode, hold the cast button to keep firing guided shots; continued fire consumes extra mana. Large mode consumes twice the base cast mana.
ui.frierenvoid.mode.title: ZOLTRAAK / CASTING MODE
ui.frierenvoid.mode.rapid.desc: Hold to keep firing gently guided beams
ui.frierenvoid.mode.large.desc: Giant seal / long charge / wide beam
spell.frierenvoid.defense.guide: Deploy a front-facing hexagonal barrier for 4 seconds. It follows your aim and absorbs arrows and spell projectiles. Excess damage passes through; rear and environmental damage are not blocked.
